mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market contraction that precedes broader economic slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) during manufacturing contraction regimes signals weakening economic output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 95.0 periods, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts increase exceeding 50,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 7.5%) indicate overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary tightening, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and UNRATE < 7.5%, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve's rate-hiking response reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals monetary tightening that raises corporate borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.
